title: Not All Jokes Land: Evaluating Large Language Models’ Understanding of Workplace Humor

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to correctly classify the appropriateness of workplace humor, specifically measuring their accuracy via F1-scores in identifying 'Offensive' jokes that target specific nations, cultures, or groups through biased content.
Assessing LLMs' capacity to identify 'Mildly Inappropriate' humor that demonstrates disrespect or relies on stereotypes directed toward particular professional roles or departments within a company.
